findings.text: Superblock record hugetlbfs_sb_info keeps access mode in mode with owner in uid and gid, allowed count in max_inodes and free count in free_inodes, statistics protection in stat_lock, size class link in hstate and pool link in spool. Helper HUGETLBFS_SB retrieves this record from generic superblock private storage.

Inode record hugetlbfs_inode_info extends generic inode in vfs_inode with reservation map link in resv_map and seal bits in seals. Helper HUGETLBFS_I derives this record from generic inode through container retrieval.

Size class record hstate guards resizing with mutex resize_lock and class key resize_key, tracks allocation cursors in next_nid_to_alloc and next_nid_to_free, and describes geometry with order plus demote_order plus mask. Name stored in name with length bound HSTATE_NAME_LEN.

Same size class record maintains global totals in max_huge_pages and nr_huge_pages with free count in free_huge_pages and reserved count in resv_huge_pages plus surplus in surplus_huge_pages and overcommit in nr_overcommit_huge_pages, active list in hugepage_activelist with free lists in hugepage_freelists, and per node totals in max_huge_pages_node plus nr_huge_pages_node plus free_huge_pages_node plus surplus_huge_pages_node.

Policy interpretation record mempolicy_interpreted carries target node in nid with optional mask link in nodemask and selection in mode. It accompanies allocation flag enumeration hugetlb_alloc_flag discussed separately.

Control group record hugetlb_cgroup holds subsystem state in css, usage counters in hugepage and reservation counters in rsvd_hugepage per size class, event counters in events with local variants in events_local, file handles in events_file with local variants in events_local_file, and trailing per node table in nodeinfo. Per node record hugetlb_cgroup_per_node holds usage per size class. Event enumeration hugetlb_memory_event defines maximum marker HUGETLB_MAX with count HUGETLB_NR_MEMORY_EVENTS.

Anonymous huge page file marker HUGETLB_ANON_FILE uses fixed name anon_hugepage. Inode kind for shared memory accounting HUGETLB_SHMFS_INODE equals 1 and kind for internal mount without that accounting HUGETLB_ANONHUGE_INODE equals 2.

Folio flag enumeration hugetlb_page_flags orders restore reserve first as HPG_restore_reserve, then migratable as HPG_migratable, temporary as HPG_temporary, freed as HPG_freed, vmemmap optimized as HPG_vmemmap_optimized, raw hardware poison unreliable as HPG_raw_hwp_unreliable, contiguous allocator as HPG_cma, and terminator as __NR_HPAGEFLAGS.

Size class name bound HSTATE_NAME_LEN equals 32. Maximum size class count HUGE_MAX_HSTATE equals 1. Boot memory option HUGE_BOOTMEM_HVO equals 1, zones valid marker HUGE_BOOTMEM_ZONES_VALID equals 2, contiguous allocator marker HUGE_BOOTMEM_CMA equals 4. Availability test hugepages_supported checks whether HPAGE_SHIFT differs from 0.

Allocation option enumeration hugetlb_alloc_flag places charge bit HUGETLB_ALLOC_CHARGE_CGROUP_RSVD_BIT at position 0 and global reservation bit HUGETLB_ALLOC_USE_GLOBAL_RESERVATIONS_BIT next. Combined mask HUGETLB_ALLOC_CHARG_CGROUP_RSVD selects charge bit and mask HUGETLB_ALLOC_USE_GLOBAL_RESERVATIONS selects global reservation bit.

Huge size helper huge_page_size scales base page size by order of given state. Shift helper huge_page_shift adds base shift to order. Mask helper huge_page_mask returns mask field of state. Order helper huge_page_order returns order field. Count helper pages_per_huge_page yields one shifted by order. Block helper blocks_per_huge_page divides huge size by 512. Order test order_is_gigantic reports true when order exceeds maximum page order, and state test hstate_is_gigantic applies same test to order of given state.

Delta helper linear_page_delta measures address distance from field vm_start in base pages. Start helper vma_start_pgoff returns field vm_pgoff of area. Index helper linear_page_index adds delta to start offset. Huge linear helper hugetlb_linear_page_index scales that index down by huge order of area state. File lock helper filemap_lock_hugetlb_folio scales huge index up by huge order before delegating to generic file lock with flag FGP_LOCK, which in turn delegates to multipolicy variant with null policy.

Default state macro default_hstate selects entry of global table hstates at default index default_hstate_idx. File helper hstate_file resolves state through inode of file. Area helper hstate_vma resolves state through file of area. Size log helper hstate_sizelog returns default for zero log, size derived state for log below bound BITS_PER_LONG, and null otherwise. Inode helper hstate_inode returns filesystem state when enabled and null when disabled. Folio helper folio_hstate validates huge marking then derives state from folio size. Index helper hstate_index_to_shift converts table position to shift, and reverse helper hstate_index converts state link to position by pointer distance.

Subpool helper subpool_inode obtains pool link from filesystem state of inode. Folio subpool reader hugetlb_folio_subpool returns pool link stored in folio, and writer hugetlb_set_folio_subpool stores given link there. Control group reader distinguishes reserved versus active links in folio, with dedicated wrappers for each case. Control group writers store given link into matching slot after validating huge marking. Disabled test reports true when subsystem is off. Duplication helper acquires extra reference on reservation map link when present, and release helpers drop references on group and map links.

Enabled file test is_file_hugepages checks flag FOP_HUGE_PAGES in operation flags fop_flags of file. Disabled variant defines same name as constant false. Setup helper hugetlb_file_setup reports error ENOSYS when disabled.

Base mask helper htlb_alloc_mask starts from flags __GFP_COMP plus __GFP_NOWARN and adds variant GFP_HIGHUSER_MOVABLE when movable is supported, otherwise variant GFP_HIGHUSER. Modifier helper htlb_modify_alloc_mask preserves requests __GFP_THISNODE and __GFP_NOWARN from caller mask while keeping base. Fallback helper htlb_allow_alloc_fallback permits cross node use for reasons MR_MEMORY_HOTPLUG plus MR_MEMORY_FAILURE plus MR_SYSCALL plus MR_MEMPOLICY_MBIND and denies otherwise.

First architecture migration test arch_hugetlb_migration_supported returns true when huge shift equals PMD_SHIFT or PUD_SHIFT or PGDIR_SHIFT, otherwise false. Second variant always returns false. Wrapper hugepage_migration_supported delegates to architecture test. Movable test hugepage_movable_supported returns false when migration is unsupported or when gigantic state lacks allowance movable_gigantic_pages, otherwise true.

Enabled flag macros generate test plus set plus clear helpers per huge flag that operate on private storage of folio with bit operations. Disabled variants generate test that always yields zero with empty set and clear. Composer macro HPAGEFLAG expands to all three helpers for given names.

Protection start helper huge_ptep_modify_prot_start derives size from area state and clears table entry while returning old value. Commit helper huge_ptep_modify_prot_commit derives same size and installs new entry. Mask align helper huge_page_mask_align combines base page mask with inverted huge mask of file state. Architecture constructor arch_make_huge_pte delegates to generic huge marker. Flush macro flush_hugetlb_tlb_range delegates to generic range flush.

Counter initializer hugetlb_count_init zeroes field hugetlb_usage of address space. Adder hugetlb_count_add increases same field by given amount. Subtractor hugetlb_count_sub decreases same field by given amount.

Page table base helper pmd_pgtable_page aligns given table link down to table size boundary using count PTRS_PER_PMD and converts result to page. Descriptor helper pmd_ptdesc derives descriptor from that page. Lock selector pmd_lockptr in split mode returns lock of that descriptor.

Huge lock selector huge_pte_lockptr warns when size equals base page size, then returns upper lock for entries at least PUD_SIZE, middle lock for entries at least PMD_SIZE and also when option CONFIG_HIGHPTE is enabled, otherwise low lock. Acquirer huge_pte_lock obtains selector result and locks it before returning handle.

Low lock selector ptep_lockptr returns descriptor lock in split mode with build checks on option CONFIG_HIGHPTE and count MAX_PTRS_PER_PTE, and returns wide lock page_table_lock otherwise. Middle selector pmd_lockptr behaves similarly with descriptor versus wide lock page_table_lock. Upper selector pud_lockptr always returns wide lock page_table_lock. Filesystem statistics lock stat_lock and size class resize mutex resize_lock guard respective state described elsewhere.

Shareable test __vma_shareable_lock reports true only when flags vm_flags allow sharing with marker VM_MAYSHARE and private data vm_private_data is present. Walker hugetlb_walk warns when shareable area is examined without held read lock on lock rw_sema or lock i_mmap_rwsem, under builds with option CONFIG_HUGETLB_PMD_PAGE_TABLE_SHARING and option CONFIG_LOCKDEP, before delegating to offset helper huge_pte_offset.

Disabled unmap helper __unmap_hugepage_range, disabled fault helper hugetlb_fault and disabled top level write test pgd_write trigger trap handling and do not complete normally, signaling unsupported use.

Folio validator VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO dumps page details and traps when condition holds in checked builds, and maps to generic validator otherwise. Generic warning VM_WARN_ON forwards to warning facility when enabled and to invalid build check otherwise. Huge lock selector warns when asked to handle base page size.

Fallback exports provide safe disabled behavior with null offset huge_pte_offset, false isolation folio_isolate_hugetlb, zero poison result get_hwpoison_hugetlb_folio, empty putback folio_putback_hugetlb and move move_hugetlb_state, zero protection result hugetlb_change_protection, empty unshare hugetlb_unshare_all_pmds plus reservation fixup fixup_hugetlb_reservations plus split hugetlb_split, zero only range is_hugepage_only_range, empty arch clear arch_clear_hugetlb_flags and poison clear folio_clear_hugetlb_hwpoison, false bootmem arch_has_huge_bootmem_alloc and false shared hugetlb_pmd_shared second variant, and empty cma reserve hugetlb_cma_reserve.

Fault entry hugetlb_fault and unmap entry __unmap_hugepage_range serve as huge page fault and teardown points, here showing disabled traps. Walk entry hugetlb_walk serves as safe table lookup that enforces sharing lock expectations before offset resolution. Shared test first variant hugetlb_pmd_shared checks shared marker in table descriptor.

Protection update follows two phase sequence with start clearing entry and returning prior value, followed by commit installing replacement with same size derivation, requiring paired use to avoid lost entries.

Huge folio flags form independent bits in private storage with test observing current value, set asserting bit and clear deasserting bit, allowing transitions between asserted and deasserted without affecting sibling bits. Disabled builds freeze all tests to deasserted with inert set and clear.

Self alias markers define names is_hugepage_only_range plus arch_clear_hugetlb_flags plus huge_ptep_modify_prot_start plus huge_ptep_modify_prot_commit to themselves to signal availability to callers.
Header guard _LINUX_HUGETLB_CGROUP_H marks inclusion of control group interface to prevent repeated processing.
